guide.what: The 10-year Treasury yield minus CPI inflation (year on year): the price of money after inflation.
read: Think P/E: growth sets the E, liquidity sets the P. Real rates measure liquidity.
Low or negative real rates relative to history mean abundant liquidity: higher valuations and a lower VIX.
High real rates relative to history mean scarce liquidity and more volatility.
watch: Compare with the VIX panel: between 2011 and 2020, real rates below 1% went with a VIX mostly between 10 and 19.
The same template applies to Japan, the UK, Germany, Italy and China (coming in phase 1c).
